why: The twelve upstream capabilities the founder named, and the two estate-native ones that close research and architecture. Each entry pins the exact upstream files the estate vendors; nothing else is copied. `skill-packs.py vendor` reads this file, fetches those files through the GitHub CLI, and writes them under packs/<id>/upstream/ with the upstream commit pinned in registry.json.

ui-ux-pro-max.title: UI/UX Pro Max -- design system, tokens, brand, banners
ui-ux-pro-max.capability: Turn a request into a token-backed design system: primitive and semantic tokens, a component spec, a brand kit, and a banner that matches the brand.
ui-ux-pro-max.description: Design-system and brand intelligence: primitive/semantic tokens, component specs and states, brand guidelines, banner design. Use when starting a front end, defining tokens, or writing a brand guideline.

awesome-design-md.title: Awesome DESIGN.md -- brand design specs as code
awesome-design-md.capability: Read and write DESIGN.md: the file that states a brand's colours, type, spacing, motion and components so an agent builds the brand instead of a generic page.
awesome-design-md.description: A corpus of real DESIGN.md brand specifications (Vercel, Raycast, Meta and more) to read as precedent and to imitate in structure. Use when writing a DESIGN.md or judging whether one is complete.

open-design.title: Open Design -- the design workspace skill set
open-design.capability: The working skills of a design workspace: brand kit, design brief, creative direction, review, colour, copy.
open-design.description: Design-workspace working skills: brand kit, design brief, creative direction, design review, colour and copy. Use when a piece of work needs a brief or a brand before any code is written.

taste.title: Taste -- critique a design against real references
taste.capability: Critique a screen the way a designer does, against a reference library of real work, with the tells named.
taste.description: Design critique with a reference library: how to read type, layout, motion, colour and imagery, and the tells that mark a design as careless. Use when reviewing a screen, a page or a mock-up.

impeccable.title: Impeccable -- the design language a harness should speak
impeccable.capability: A craft floor for an agent: audit, critique, refine and document a design, with the bar written down before the work starts.
impeccable.description: A design-language skill set for coding agents: audit and critique a design, refine it, and keep the craft floor explicit. Use when improving an existing interface or setting a quality bar for a new one.

react-bits.title: React Bits -- animated React components you can drop in
react-bits.capability: Pick and adapt animated React components (text, backgrounds, buttons, containers) instead of writing a bespoke animation from scratch.
react-bits.description: A library of animated, copy-paste React components: text animations, gradient backgrounds, buttons, containers, and the shape/texture tools behind them. Use when building an interactive front end and animation is part of the brief.

emil-design-skills.title: Design engineering skills -- craft, motion and native feel
emil-design-skills.capability: Design-engineering craft: animation vocabulary and performance, native-feeling mobile UI, Apple design language, and breaking the template look.
emil-design-skills.description: Design-engineering skills for coding agents: animation vocabulary and performance, animation review, native mobile UI, Apple design language, and how to break the generic template look. Use when motion or platform feel is the problem.

hallmark.title: Hallmark -- web design craft, macrostructures and gates
hallmark.capability: The anatomy of a good page: macrostructures, layout, type, flow, interaction states, and the gates a design must pass before it ships.
hallmark.description: A web-design craft manual: page anatomy, macrostructures (hero, bento, long document, stat-led, workbench and more), layout, typography, interaction states and the gates that decide a design is ready. Use when designing or judging a page end to end.

design-md.title: Google DESIGN.md -- the specification and its linter
design-md.capability: The DESIGN.md specification itself, with worked examples and the linter that checks one, so a brand spec is a checkable artifact rather than prose.
design-md.description: The DESIGN.md format: the specification, worked brand examples, and the agent skills that write and scale one. Use when authoring a DESIGN.md, or when a front end must answer to a written design system.

gsap-skills.title: GSAP skills -- motion that runs at 60fps
gsap-skills.capability: GSAP used correctly: core tweens and timelines, ScrollTrigger, plugins, React integration, and the performance rules that keep it smooth.
gsap-skills.description: Official GSAP skills for coding agents: core animation, timelines, ScrollTrigger, plugins, React and framework integration, and performance. Use when a page needs motion that is smooth and controllable.

scroll-world.title: Scroll World -- a brand as a scrollable 3D world
scroll-world.capability: Turn a brand into a scroll-scrubbed 3D world landing page, with the scrub engine and the prompts that produce it.
scroll-world.description: A skill for building scroll-scrubbed 3D world landing pages: the scrub engine, the pipeline, and the prompts. Use when a landing page needs to feel like a place rather than a page.

canvas-ui.title: Canvas UI -- canvas and WebGL interface primitives
canvas-ui.capability: Canvas/WebGL UI primitives for interfaces that cannot be DOM: 3D scenes, shaders, and interactive canvases inside a product.
canvas-ui.description: A canvas/WebGL UI kit for interfaces that DOM cannot express: interactive canvases, 3D scenes and shader-driven visuals inside a product. Use when a screen needs a canvas rather than a document.

estate-research.title: Estate research -- how an agent finds out
estate-research.capability: Research inside the estate: the harvest intent for capability, search-text and explore for the corpus, the knowledge graph for what is already known, and the rule that a claim needs a source.
estate-research.description: How to research inside the estate: harvest capabilities, search the corpus, query the knowledge graph, and cite a source for every claim. Use when a task needs facts the agent does not hold.

estate-architecture.title: Estate architecture -- how a decision gets written down
estate-architecture.capability: Architecture inside the estate: one of each layer, a spec before the build, a decision record for every fork, and the gates that prove the shape is right.
estate-architecture.description: How architecture is decided and recorded in the estate: one of each layer, spec before build, a decision doc for every fork, and the gates that prove a shape. Use when choosing a shape, not when writing the code.
